name: Editorial
description: Sophisticated print-publishing aesthetic featuring warm tactile surfaces, literary typography, elegant bylines, and graceful column pacing.
designPrinciples: Literary authority and high-craft print sensibility
Warm, tactile cream and parchment background evoking fine paper stock
Sophisticated contrast between deep charcoal ink and rich wine accents
Deliberate editorial pacing with bylines, pull quotes, and folio markers

guidelines: Serif display headlines with natural line breaks
Include a small uppercase tracking kicker above main headlines
Distinguish bylines and dates in muted sans-serif or italic serif

layout.structure: Magazine-spread columnar layout with feature header and editorial columns
layout.spacing: Balanced editorial margins (40px) with comfortable reading line lengths
layout.alignment: Refined justify or flush-left editorial text blocks
rules: Include a headline section with kicker tag, main title, and subtitle
Use delicate horizontal divider rules (#E7E5E4) to segment story sections
Incorporate a highlighted pull-quote or stat callout with wine #881337 accents

allowedEffects: pull quotes with enlarged quote marks
patternsToAvoid: Industrial raw monospace typography for primary content
